<thought>Search the retrosynthetic template database for templates that, in the forward direction, break a t‑butyldimethylsilyl group and form an aliphatic hydroxyl. The target molecule is the provided SMILES.</thought>
<action>search_template_catalog_by_criteria</action>
<action_input>{
    "molecule_smiles": "O[C@H]1C[C@@H](O[C@@H]([C@@H]1C)/C=C(CO)/C)C/C=C/C=C/C(O)=O",
    "functional_groups_broken": ["t-butyldimethylsilyl"],
    "functional_groups_formed": ["aliphatic hydroxyls"],
    "limit": 10
}</action_input>
